title: Kemalist Preference, Reichstag Fallback — Timeline Compression Forces the Loud Exit
statement: The regime's genuine preference is the Kemalist route — the quiet, horizontal, court-and-bureaucracy transition to authoritarianism that never needs a dramatic emergency. But the Kemalist track requires the luxury of time, and they have run out of it (SPR at the ~290M floor draining with no refill; sailors unpaid; a losing Iran war; Republican infighting splitting the Department of War; dissent that can only be managed, not healed). We compress their timeline by exposing the drains — so we are predicting not which transition THEY will choose, but what our compressing of their timeline will force them to FALL BACK on. The Reichstag fire is not their plan; it is their fallback when the Kemalist plan fails against the clock. Every outcome has a pre-written contingency (October trigger if they fear losing; extended timeline if they can rig/court-contest; Democratic legislature as a delay-plan not a defeat; false-flag/domestic attack as the loudest held card). Governing thesis: WO WE ARE FORCING THE REICHSTAG FIRE MOMENT BECAUSE THEY ARE RUNNING OUT OF TIME.

The secondary leadership (hardline inner circle) facing imminent loss of institutional cover has a rational incentive to trigger the LAME-DUCK LOUD TRACK preemptively—seizing emergency powers or forcing a crisis *before* succession is contested or the opposition consolidates.
